name: BarCompare
description: 2-6 bars that grow one after another, each value counting up with its label; one bar is highlighted. Columns, switching to rows by itself when the box is narrow or labels are long. All text is fitted to the clip box; labels are never larger than values.

items.description: the bars, left to right (top to bottom when horizontal)

value.description: bar length; negative values are drawn by their size

display.description: text shown instead of the counting value, e.g. 1.2万

tone.description: this bar's colour: theme token or CSS (default: muted, accent for the highlighted one)

at.description: Time this bar starts growing: "line:9" or seconds from the clip start. Default: one after another from `at`

unit.description: appended to each counting value, e.g. 元, %, 升

decimals.description: decimal places of the values; default: as written

orientation.description: auto: columns, or rows when the column labels or values would read small (narrow boxes, long labels); vertical forces columns

highlight.description: index of the bar in the accent colour; -1 for none. Default: the last

max.description: the value a full-length bar stands for; default: the largest value (set it to compare across clips)

at.description: Time the first bar starts growing: "line:8" or seconds from the clip start. Default: 0.2 s into the clip

stagger.description: seconds between bars that have no `at` of their own

color.description: the highlight colour: theme token or CSS

ground.description: what it sits on; sets text and plain-bar colours
